title: Galaxy Power Spectrum at Two-Loop Order: Implications for Weak Lensing Surveys and New Physics
summary: We compute the galaxy power spectrum at two-loop order in cosmological perturbation theory (effective field theory, EFT). We derive galaxy bias operators through the fifth order and obtain two-loop renormalization conditions for their bias coefficients. We also derive the relevant higher-derivative and stochastic contributions, and implement IR resummation using time-sliced perturbation theory. We obtain the complete dark-matter and galaxy renormalization conditions for the higher-derivative operators at the power spectrum, bispectrum, and trispectrum level.
